<script>
if (!window.storage) {
  window.storage = {
    async get(key, shared) {
      const raw = localStorage.getItem('bk_' + key);
      if (raw === null) throw new Error('not found');
      return { key, value: raw, shared: !!shared };
    },
    async set(key, value, shared) {
      localStorage.setItem('bk_' + key, value);
      return { key, value, shared: !!shared };
    },
    async delete(key, shared) {
      localStorage.removeItem('bk_' + key);
      return { key, deleted: true, shared: !!shared };
    },
    async list(prefix, shared) {
      const keys = [];
      for (let i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        const k = localStorage.key(i);
        if (k && k.startsWith('bk_' + (prefix || ''))) keys.push(k.slice(3));
      }
      return { keys, prefix, shared: !!shared };
    }
  };
}
if ('serviceWorker' in navigator) {
  // A controllerchange with a controller already present (this device had
  // an active service worker before this event) means a NEW one just took
  // over — a genuine update, not the first-ever install claiming a fresh
  // page. showUpdateAvailableToast() is defined later in the main bundle,
  // but this listener only actually fires well after that script has run.
  const hadController = !!navigator.serviceWorker.controller;
  navigator.serviceWorker.addEventListener('controllerchange', () => {
    if (hadController && typeof showUpdateAvailableToast === 'function') showUpdateAvailableToast();
  });
  window.addEventListener('load', () => {
    navigator.serviceWorker.register('./service-worker.js').catch(() => {});
  });
}
</script>
